trailing_stop_artifact_check.note: The primary 6 variants above all use a 3-cent trailing stop, which turned out to fire on 89 percent of momentum trades -- those exits average -6.06 percent return (25.8 percent win rate), while the 10 percent of trades that were NOT stopped out (rode to the fixed time exit) average +19.10 percent return with a 77.1 percent win rate. That split is checked directly here by rerunning momentum_30min and reversal_30min with the trailing stop effectively disabled (delta=1.0, never fires), isolating whether the negative headline result was a real absence of momentum or an artifact of a stop placed too tight for this population volatility.
